name: Mythic Course + 1-on-1 Coaching
tagline: Any rank to Mythic, guaranteed. Full video course, homework that moves your rank, and a personal 1-on-1 with Ryvoki.
features: 8 modules from setup to the Mythic push, beginner to advanced
Reading, drills and homework with every lesson, not just videos
A training plan built from your intake: platform, rank, confidence, how often you play
1-on-1 call with Ryvoki when you finish: he watches you play and hands you a personal fix-list
Private students channel in the Discord
Mythic guaranteed: coaching continues until you get there
body: This is the exact process I use to climb every season, turned into a course you can actually finish. Eight modules, short lessons, and after every lesson you get homework that goes straight into your ranked games.
You start with an intake: platform, current rank, how confident you are with aim and movement, and how often you can train. The course builds a plan around that so you always know what to do next.
When you complete the course you book a 1-on-1 call. I watch you play and give you a personal plan of the three things that will move your rank fastest.
setup: Buy the course. Your license key appears on this site the moment payment confirms.
Go to ryvoki.com/learn and log in with your key.
Answer the intake questions once. Your plan is built from them.
Work through the lessons and do the homework in ranked.
Finish the course, book your 1-on-1, get your personal fix-list.

name: Blood Strike Rank Tracker
tagline: A live rank / RP / wins overlay for OBS. Offline, transparent, zero game hooks.
features: Transparent 360×90 overlay card built for an OBS Browser Source
Rank badge, ranked points and wins-today, all updated live over Server-Sent Events
Tiny native control panel: pick rank, type RP, tap +/− for wins
Auto-saves every change with crash-safe atomic writes and a backup
Runs fully offline on 127.0.0.1 — never touches the game, no accounts, no telemetry
Single self-contained EXE, no .NET install needed
body: I got tired of retyping my rank in a text source every time I ranked up on stream, so I built this. You keep a small control panel open next to OBS, change your rank, RP or wins, and the overlay updates instantly.
It is completely separate from Blood Strike. It does not read game memory, inject anything, or talk to any server. It is a manual tracker with a pretty face.
Your license key unlocks the app on up to 3 PCs. Payment is crypto only and your key shows up on this site the moment the payment is confirmed.
setup: Download and unzip the folder anywhere. Keep the folder together.
Run Ryvoki Blood Strike Rank Tracker.exe and paste your license key when asked.
In OBS add a Browser Source: URL http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay, width 360, height 90.
Change rank / RP / wins in the control panel. The overlay updates live.
